notes: All 12 views inspected. Combine harvester with a wide cutter bar carrying a modelled reel with bats and tines, a feeder house, a glazed cab with a roof, a grain tank, an unloading auger swung out to one side, an engine bay with a cooling fan and grilles, an access ladder, and four wheels with agricultural tread. The underside shows the chassis, drive axles and the underside of the cutter bar. The reel and all four wheels are SEPARATE nodes with correct pivots, so reel-spin, wheel-roll and steering clips can be authored.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The unloading auger is fused in the extended position and cannot be folded.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
